# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 27 Jul 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Private Home Prices: Q2 2026 Snapshot

- **Private home prices edged up 0.5% in Q2 2026, slowest first-half growth since 2020** - URA's latest data shows the overall private residential price index rose 0.5% QoQ in Q2 2026, easing from 0.9% in Q1, with non-landed prices dipping even as resale transactions drove a 13.6% rise in total sales volume. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/singapore-condo-prices-just-had-their-slowest-first-half-since-2020/)

- **HDB resale prices fell 0.3% for a second consecutive quarter — but million-dollar flat sales hit a record 491 units** - HDB's Resale Price Index slipped 0.3% QoQ in Q2 2026, continuing a two-quarter decline, even as transaction activity edged higher and record numbers of flats transacted above S$1 million. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/hdb-resale-prices-fall-for-a-second-straight-quarter-but-million-dollar-flat-sales-just-hit-a-record-high/)

## New Launches & Land Sales

- **Dunearn House sold 55% at launch, with three-bedroom unit types fully taken up** - 211 of 380 units were sold over the July 25–26 launch weekend; three-bedroom and three-bedroom + flexi units sold out completely, though the overall take-up rate trailed the 2026 new launch average of 75.8%. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/dunearn-house-sold-55-at-launch-but-one-unit-type-sold-out-completely/)

- **Lentor Gardens Residences sold 270 units on launch day at an average of S$2,350 psf** - The project moved 270 of its 499 units on 18 July 2026, achieving a 54% take-up rate on launch day. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/lentor-gardens-residences-sells-270-units-at-an-average-of-s2350-psf/)

- **October 2026 BTO launch to offer 7,970 flats across seven projects** - Sites include two Bayshore locations near Bayshore MRT, a likely Prime-classified project in Toa Payoh (Caldecott area), and Tengah's first BTO launch in three years. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/we-review-the-october-2026-bto-launch-sites/)

## Mortgage Rates

- **SORA has fallen to around 1.14% after peaking near 4% in 2023–2024** - The drop has opened a refinancing window for both HDB and condo owners, though the article notes the cheapest headline rate is not always the most suitable loan structure. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/singapores-best-mortgage-rates-are-back-but-cheapest-home-loan-isnt-always-the-best-one/)
